title: A call is to be fetched from an external system
description: data of likho.import.requested.v1; published by likho-api on NATS subject likho.import.requested when a person or a schedule asks for a call by its id in the dialer

source.description: Which connector: the system the call comes from, e.g. ameyo

external_id.description: The call's id in that system (the dialer's crt_object_id)

requested_by.description: The person who asked, when one did

transcribe.description: Start a transcription once the recording is stored (default true)
